items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know (he was) Benny Carter's was (unintelligible) cousin.

ctx.x: From Billy Douglas. See, but what happened. Billy didn't get it from him to give to (unintelligible), but Billy followed him, because Cuban was the first one came around with all them chords on the trumpet. That was Benny Carter's cousin.
